Finding the Correct Contract

The symbols above are root symbols. When trading, make sure you select the appropriate active contract month and year.
​

For example:

NQ = E-mini Nasdaq-100
​MNQ = Micro E-mini Nasdaq-100
​GC = Gold
​MGC = Micro Gold
​

Always confirm the correct market and contract before submitting an order ✅
